entities.label: Pi
entities.summary: Upstream TypeScript coding agent; the behavior oracle.

entities.label: PiG
entities.summary: The Go implementation; executable pig.

entities.label: Stock PiG
entities.summary: Product-neutral pig binary with no Piglet selected.

entities.label: Session
entities.summary: Append-only JSONL tree of entries for one conversation.

entities.label: Model Runtime
entities.summary: Session-owned model lookup, auth, completion, and streaming used by every mode.

entities.label: Provider
entities.summary: Turns a Transcript into one Event Stream for one API.

entities.label: Mode
entities.summary: Interactive TUI, print, JSON event stream, or RPC over stdin/stdout.

entities.label: Resource
entities.summary: One capability: extension, skill, prompt, hook, MCP definition, theme, or environment.

entities.label: Extension
entities.summary: Code Resource in Go, Rust, Python, or Node/TypeScript that registers tools, commands, events, and UI.

entities.label: Extension SDK
entities.summary: One extension contract per language: Go, Rust, Python, TypeScript declarations.
entities.where: scaffolded per language by pig extension init

entities.label: Extension realization
entities.summary: How an extension runs: isolated process, packed runtime cell, or fused into a Piglet Binary (Go only).

entities.label: Extension Host
entities.summary: Loads, isolates, reloads, and shuts down extension realizations over one wire contract.

entities.label: Package
entities.summary: Versioned collection of Resources from npm, git, or a local path; never owns a Piglet.

entities.label: Piglet
entities.summary: One named agent: selects and scopes Resources and sets defaults.

entities.label: PiG Standard
entities.summary: The optional curated Piglet: login identity, PiG Runner, Angry Pigs.

entities.label: Piglet release
entities.summary: Pins the exact Resource closure and component plan of a Piglet.

entities.label: Piglet Binary
entities.summary: Target-native pig executable for one Piglet release; verifies its closure at startup and compiles out the built-ins its strip lists name.

entities.label: Builder
entities.summary: Produces Piglet Binaries: native (needs Go and PiG source) or container (needs Docker or Podman).

entities.label: Slot
entities.summary: A part of PiG that a Piglet can change: keep PiG's own part, replace it with a fused member (today the frontend), or strip it.
entities.where: slots: and strip: in the Piglet file

entities.label: Strip list
entities.summary: Disables built-in tools, commands, extensions, APIs, or features by stable ID; tools: is a ceiling, strip removes.
entities.inspect: pig piglet schema, pig piglet show <name>

entities.label: Overlay Piglet
entities.summary: A Piglet chosen at launch on a Piglet Binary that is not built with build.closed; it can undo runtime strips but not compiled-out ones.

entities.label: Divergence
entities.summary: A numbered, approved, user-visible difference from pinned Pi.

relations: TUI, print, JSON, RPC share one Session path
tools is a ceiling; strip removes built-ins
by stable ID, in runtime or binary
refused only by a Binary built with build.closed
